entities.name: Query kynureninase
observations: 416 aa protein; estimated molecular weight 46.39 kDa, theoretical pI 5.68, and charge at pH 7 of about -9.43.
Matches curated Burkholderia mallei kynureninases at 65.6% identity with 100% query and target coverage; E-value 8.36e-201.
Contains Pfam Aminotran_5 (PF00266.26) at residues 77–351 and KYNU_C (PF22580.3) at residues 306–395.
Likely a cytoplasmic PLP-dependent kynureninase, but exact substrate preference remains homology-based rather than experimentally established for this sequence.

entities.name: Burkholderia kynureninase
observations: Curated homologs A3MHE2, A2S925, and Q62M98 are annotated as kynureninases.
Catalyze PLP-dependent cleavage of L-kynurenine to anthranilate and L-alanine, and 3-hydroxy-L-kynurenine to 3-hydroxyanthranilate and L-alanine.
Annotated as homodimers and cytoplasmic proteins; EC 3.7.1.3.
A conserved PLP-linked lysine is annotated at reference position 227; reference binding-site positions are not directly mapped onto the query sequence.

entities.name: Pyridoxal 5-phosphate
observations: Curated kynureninase homologs use pyridoxal 5'-phosphate as cofactor; ChEBI:CHEBI:597326.

entities.name: Kynurenine degradation
observations: Kynureninase homologs participate in L-kynurenine degradation, producing anthranilate and L-alanine.

entities.name: NAD+ biosynthesis
observations: Kynureninase homologs are annotated in the quinolinate branch of NAD+ biosynthesis from L-kynurenine.
